**Our Operating Principles**
***Extreme Ownership***
We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.
  
  
***Craftsmanship***
Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.
  
  
***We are “majos”***
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.
  
  
***Urgency with Focus***
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.
  
  
***Talent Density and Meritocracy***
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.
  
  
***First-Principles Thinking***
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

GHX is seeking a Software Engineer with strong technical skills and growing experience in designing, developing, and delivering quality software solutions. You will join the Rules and Actions team and report to the Manager of Engineering. The team owns the rules engine at the core of the GHX Exchange platform. That engine evaluates routing and business rules against document events and runs the resulting actions, such as routing, notifications, and document processing, for healthcare supply chain transactions.
The ideal candidate is proficient in Java and the J2EE/Spring stack, has exposure to AWS cloud services and event-driven systems, and is developing skills in CI/CD pipelines and software design patterns.
What You'll Work On
- Build and enhance features in the rules execution service. It consumes EventBus document events, runs the rule engine, and publishes outcomes such as route-found and no-route-found.
- Implement rule types, specifications, and actions on the shared rules framework and Exchange extension libraries, following established patterns.
- Support EventBus-driven rules, including MongoDB-backed rule definitions, event matching, and rule caching.
- Contribute to Intelligent Business Rules (IBR) capabilities such as business-rule statistics and change-request persistence.
- Develop and maintain rule actions for document handling and integrations, with guidance from senior engineers. Ship changes behind feature flags.
- Write JUnit 5 and Mockito tests, and help with ongoing monolith decoupling and Java version migrations.
Duties and Responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable, secure, and maintainable software that aligns with business needs and is flexible, reusable, and efficient.
- Translate ideas into clear, high-quality code under the guidance of senior engineers.
- Contribute to technical design for features and stories. Document your work and follow IT control policies.
- Work with your team and cross-functional partners to address technical dependencies, review ideas and concerns, and deliver high-quality products.
- Identify issues of limited scope, analyze their impact, and resolve them independently or with guidance from senior team members.
- Follow best practices for design, development, testing, and Agile workflows.
- Build professional relationships within the team to support collaboration and knowledge sharing.
- Develop an understanding of the rules subsystems, their components, and how they interact (EventBus, MongoDB, ConfigSvc, Elasticsearch) to support feature development.
Qualifications
- Minimum of 2–3 years of software development experience
- BS in Computer Science, or similar work experience
- 2+ years developing solutions with Java and J2EE technologies (Spring, Maven)
- Working knowledge of cloud technologies. AWS experience with EC2, SNS, SQS, S3, or Lambda is nice to have.
- Experience with databases. MongoDB, Elasticsearch, and MySQL are nice to have.
- Exposure to a rules engine and/or event-driven architecture (event buses, publish/subscribe messaging)
- Familiarity with AI tools and willingness to learn emerging technologies
- Understanding of design best practices, including performance and scalability
- Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment
- Able to work independently on well-defined tasks and collaboratively as part of a team
- Experience delivering moderate-complexity features
- Strong problem-solving and communication skills
Nice to Have
- Exposure to Liquibase or other database migration tools
- Experience with feature flags or configuration services
- Interest in healthcare, supply chain, or EDI/B2B document exchange
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
- Delivers high-quality results on assigned tasks with attention to detail and commitment to excellence
- Communicates technical concepts clearly to team members and immediate stakeholders
- Collaborates effectively within the team and with other departments
- Is developing an understanding of how individual work affects the broader system and team goals
